## agent-ml-research
ML research experiment management tools

attachment.content:
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").
- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).
TRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.
SKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- review: Review a pull request
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

issues:
  # ============================================================
  # Round 1-2 历史 issues（保留完整记录）
  # ============================================================
  - id: R1-N1
    summary: "EDD 公式 (Eq.1) 存在系统性 off-by-one 错误，公式输出值比全文报告值小 1"
    category: method
    severity: critical
    status: resolved
    first_raised_round: 1
    last_seen_round: 1
    mentions:
      - round: 1
        reviewers: [1, 2]
        note: "R1 发现，R2 独立验证确认。Eq.1 定义 EDD_T=max{d*:AUC(d*,d*+1)>=T}，Pythia nucleus d0-d5 T=0.75 时公式得 3 但报告 4。Table 3 所有行均差 1。需修正公式为 max{d*+1:...} 或全文数值下调 1。"
    action_items:
      - round: 1
        action: "修正 Eq.1 公式定义为 EDD_T = max{d*+1 : AUC(d*,d*+1)>=T}，报告值不变"
        assigned_to: paper_agent
        status: done
    resolution: "method.tex Eq.1 已修正为 max{d*+1:...}，报告值不变。"
    resolution_round: 2

  - id: R1-N2
    summary: "主实验 Table 1/2 无 std/CI/significance test，无法判断方法间差异是否显著"
    category: experiment
    severity: critical
    status: resolved
    first_raised_round: 1
    last_seen_round: 1
    mentions:
      - round: 1
        reviewers: [1, 2]
        note: "R1 列为 critical，R2 同意但建议分两级：Table 1 加 fold-level std (must-fix)，Table 2 方法间 significance test (should-fix)。5-fold CV 天然产生 fold estimates，报告 mean±std 成本为零。"
    action_items:
      - round: 1
        action: "修改 atlas_v2_analysis.py 保存 fold-level metrics，重跑 9 cell，Table 1/2 加 ±std"
        assigned_to: main_agent
        status: done
        note: "Reviewer 确认 fold std 0.002-0.009，极稳定。数据与 registry 一致 (Δ<1pp)。"
      - round: 1
        action: "RF vs CORAL/DivEye/CE-MLP paired bootstrap test"
        assigned_to: main_agent
        status: done
        note: "RF vs DivEye p=0.096 (n.s.), RF vs CORAL p=0.048 (Bonferroni n.s.), RF vs CE-MLP p<0.001。触发 D022 叙事重构。"
      - round: 1
        action: "Paper Agent 更新叙事：RF ≈ CORAL ≈ DivEye >> CE-MLP，强调特征而非分类器"
        assigned_to: paper_agent
        status: done
      - round: 1
        action: "9-cell fold-level std 补充验证"
        assigned_to: main_agent
        status: done
    resolution: "数据+叙事全部完成。fold std + bootstrap + Paper Agent D022 patch 均已落地。9-cell fold std 0.20%-0.87% 确认极高稳定性。"
    resolution_round: 1

  - id: R1-N3
    summary: "DCOL negative result 证据不足：仅 1 架构 6 配置（5 个失败），不足以支撑 end-to-end 方法劣于特征工程的结论"
    category: experiment
    severity: critical
    status: resolved
    first_raised_round: 1
    last_seen_round: 1
    mentions:
      - round: 1
        reviewers: [1, 2]
        note: "两位 Reviewer 独立发现并达成完全共识。补充简单 end-to-end baselines 或弱化结论。"
    action_items:
      - round: 1
        action: "补充 DeBERTa-v3-base + RoBERTa-base 直接 finetune 4-class baseline"
        assigned_to: main_agent
        status: done
      - round: 1
        action: "Feature overlap analysis: DeBERTa attention vs RF permutation importance"
        assigned_to: main_agent
        status: done
      - round: 1
        action: "论文中纳入双 backbone 结果 + feature overlap 分析，升级 Section 5.4"
        assigned_to: paper_agent
        status: done
    resolution: "双 backbone (DeBERTa 58.3%, RoBERTa 59.5%) 均远低于 RF 78.2%，差距 ~19pp。Feature overlap analysis (ρ=-0.484) 提供机理解释。论文已全面更新。"
    resolution_round: 2

  - id: R2-N2
    summary: "Mohamed et al. (ACL 2025) 'LLM as a Broken Telephone' 高度相关但未讨论"
    category: writing
    severity: critical
    status: resolved
    first_raised_round: 1
    last_seen_round: 1
    mentions:
      - round: 1
        reviewers: [1, 2]
        note: "R2 发现，R1 同意。同时恢复 dohmatob2024 两篇和 cloc2025 的引用。"
    action_items:

    resolution_round: 2

  - id: R1-W1

    category: method
    severity: warning
    status: resolved
    first_raised_round: 1
    last_seen_round: 3
    mentions:

        reviewers: [1, 2]
        note: "R1 提出，R2 同意。Reviewer 反审确认：即使 permutation importance 改变排名，universality claim 基于跨 cell 一致性（ρ=0.868）仍成立，但需弱化从 p90_ppl dominates 到 perplexity tail statistics category dominates。"
      - round: 3
        reviewers: [1, 2]
        note: "Gini vs permutation importance 交叉验证已完成（Appendix A.2），但 R3 新发现更深层问题——需 top-2/top-5 消融量化独立维度数（见 R3-N2）。"
    action_items:

        action: "计算 19×19 correlation matrix + permutation importance，加入 Appendix"
        assigned_to: main_agent
        status: done
      - round: 1
        action: "Paper Agent 将 permutation importance 结果纳入论文 Appendix"
        assigned_to: paper_agent
        status: done
    resolution: "Permutation importance 分析已在 Appendix A.2。更深层消融由 R3-N2 追踪。"
    resolution_round: 2

  - id: R1-W2
    summary: "Wikipedia seed text 引入 domain bias，d0 recall >99% 可能部分反映文体特征"
    category: experiment
    severity: warning

      - round: 3

        note: "R3 两位 Reviewer 再次独立提出 d0 inflation 问题（见 R3-W1），要求在 headline 中并列报告 d1-d3 accuracy。问题持续存在。"
    action_items:

        assigned_to: director
        status: open
    resolution: ""

    severity: warning
    status: resolved
    first_raised_round: 1
    last_seen_round: 1

        reviewers: [1, 2]
        note: "添加标准参数引用即可。"
    action_items:

        action: "method.tex 加 LoRA 参数依据引用 Hu et al. 2022"
        assigned_to: paper_agent
        status: done
    resolution: "method.tex 已加引用依据。"
    resolution_round: 2

  - id: R1-W4
    summary: "Zero-shot LLM baseline 仅 200 samples，CI 宽"

    severity: warning
    status: in_progress
    first_raised_round: 1
    last_seen_round: 3
    mentions:

        reviewers: [1, 2]
        note: "差距 38pp >> CI 6.8pp，统计上足以区分。可在 rebuttal 论证或扩展到 500 samples。"
      - round: 3
        reviewers: [1, 2]
        note: "R3 两位 Reviewer 再次提出（R1-W4, R2-W3），额外指出 prompt 设计未报告、仅一个 LLM baseline。建议增至 1000+ samples 或在 abstract 标注 CI。"
    action_items:
      - round: 1
        action: "Rebuttal 论证 200 samples 足够区分 40% vs 78%，或扩展到 500 samples"
        assigned_to: director
        status: open
      - round: 3
        action: "zeroshot_llm_500_001 已审批执行，扩展到 500 samples + 报告 prompt 设计"
        assigned_to: main_agent
        status: in_progress
    resolution: ""
    resolution_round: null

  - id: R1-W5
    summary: "5-fold CV 未说明是否按 passage lineage 分组，存在数据泄漏风险"

        note: "代码验证无条件生成（BOS token），passages 间无跨 depth lineage。问题不存在。"
    action_items:

        action: "method.tex 加一句澄清无条件生成设计"

## 审查报告 — xgboost_lgbm_baseline_001

**结论**: PASS with notes

### 核心结果

| 方法 | 4-class Acc | d0v1 AUC | d1v2 AUC | d2v3 AUC |
|------|------------|----------|----------|----------|
| RF (hardcoded ref) | 78.2% | 0.861 | ~ | 0.800 |
| XGBoost (GPU) | 79.0% ±0.5% | 1.000 | 0.931 | 0.816 |
| LightGBM (CPU) | 78.8% ±0.8% | 1.000 | 0.931 | 0.814 |

三分类器趋同于 ~78-79%，支持"信号天花板在特征层而非分类器"的叙事。XGBoost-RF 差距 0.8pp 在 5-fold CV 噪声范围内。

### 发现

**1. [severity: info] GPU 使用合规。** XGBoost 用 `device="cuda:0"`（白名单内）。LightGBM 尝试 GPU 失败（无 OpenCL）回退到 CPU。

**2. [severity: warning] 仅在 1/9 cells（pythia_nucleus095）上测试。** "Feature ceiling" 结论基于单 cell。论文如说 "classifiers converge" 需限定为 "on the representative nucleus cell"，不能泛化到全 9 cells。建议至少补 1-2 个差异大的 cell（如 gpt2xl_temp09 acc=86% 或 pythia_topk50 acc=69%）验证天花板效应在不同基础准确率下是否仍成立。

**3. [severity: warning] RF 参考值是硬编码的，非同框架计算。**

脚本直接打印：`RF (reference) 78.2% +/- ? 0.861 ~ 0.800`

RF 的 pairwise AUC（d0v1=0.861）与 XGBoost/LightGBM（d0v1=1.000）差异 0.139，远超 accuracy 差异。这高度怀疑两者的 AUC 不是同一评估协议：
- XGBoost/LightGBM：4-class 模型的 class probability ratio 算 pairwise AUC
- RF reference 0.861：可能来自 binary pairwise 评估（depth_extension 实验）

**论文中的 AUC 对比表不能直接混用不同评估协议的数字。** 建议用同一 `run_cv` 函数重新跑 RF，确保 4-class probability → pairwise AUC 的计算一致。

**4. [severity: info] 无超参调优。** XGBoost/LightGBM 使用 n_est=200, depth=6, lr=0.1。对于证明"天花板"而言足够——如果调优后仍在 ~79-80% 就更有说服力。当前默认参数下已趋同，审稿人可能问"调优后是否突破"。

**5. [severity: info] d2 recall 0.596 跨方法一致。** XGBoost/LightGBM/RF 都在 d2 表现最差，这是特征层系统性限制，与 EDD 衰减叙事一致。

## 综合审查报告 #4 — xgboost_lgbm_3cell / plan_015 设计 / w2 LOGO

---

### 1. xgboost_lgbm_3cell_001 审查

**结论**: PASS

**数据一致性**: 服务器 `results/xgb_lgbm_3cell/results.json` 与 registry metrics 一致。逐 cell 验证：
- pythia_nuc: RF 78.7% / XGB 79.0% / LGBM 78.9% — 跨分类器 range 0.3pp ✅
- gpt2xl_temp09: RF 85.8% / XGB 86.2% / LGBM 86.2% — range 0.5pp ✅
- pythia_topk50: RF 68.9% / XGB 68.9% / LGBM 68.7% — range 0.2pp ✅

**AUC 协议修复**: 旧 RF d0v1=0.861 → 新统一协议 RF d0v1=0.9996。代码中 pairwise AUC 使用 `prob_j/(prob_i+prob_j)` 归一化后计算，这是正确的 pairwise probability 方法。旧值 0.861 应为 multi-class OvR AUC 的评估伪影。

**发现**:
- [severity: info] 特征天花板结论成立：三种分类器（RF/XGBoost/LightGBM）在每个 cell 内 ≤0.5pp 差异，信号瓶颈在 19 维特征而非分类器。
- [severity: info] 代码对 inf/nan 做了 percentile clipping (0.1/99.9)，对比未 clipping 的原 RF 78.2% → 新 RF 78.7%，影响 ~0.5pp，可忽略。
- [severity: warning] **仅测试 3/9 cells**（pythia_nuc, gpt2xl_temp09, pythia_topk50）。论文若声称 "across all cells" 需限定语言或补全 9 cell。3 个 cell 覆盖了不同模型 + 不同策略 + 不同难度梯度（69-86%），对 feature ceiling claim 已有说服力，但严谨起见应注明。
- [severity: info] GPU 合规：sklearn RF 为 CPU 运算，XGBoost 在 `xgboost_lgbm_baseline_001` 中用 cuda:0（白名单内），3cell 版本脚本未见 GPU device 指定，推测 CPU 运行。

---

### 2. plan_015 wild_data_calibration.py 设计审查

Worker 产出了完整脚本 `src/wild_data_calibration.py`（681 行），覆盖三个子测试：A (d0 FPR)、B (mixed-domain 4-class acc)、C (feature distribution shift KS + MMD)。尚未注册 registry 或部署到服务器。

**发现**:
- [severity: warning] **Reference model 默认值不匹配**：脚本默认 `--reference_model gpt2`（GPT-2 small 124M），但 controlled features 的 perplexity/surprisal 由各 cell 的评估模型提取（Pythia-1.4B / GPT-2 XL / OLMo-1B）。不同 reference model 的绝对 perplexity 分布根本不同，直接拼接会导致 Test A/B 结果不可解释（域偏移 ≠ 深度信号偏移）。**建议**：(1) 默认值改为 None 并强制用户指定; (2) 或在脚本中增加 reference model 一致性检查，与 controlled features 的 evaluator 匹配。
- [severity: info] RedPajama 下载正确排除了 Wikipedia 源，避免与训练数据域重叠。
- [severity: info] Test C 设计合理：Bonferroni 校正多重比较 + MMD(RBF) 双重度量分布偏移。
- [severity: info] Test B 的非对称设计（wild d0 + controlled d1-d3）是该实验固有限制（无法获得 wild d>0 数据），需在论文中明确承认。
- [severity: info] n_estimators=100 vs 主实验 200，轻微不一致但影响可忽略。

### 3. w2_domain_bias Sub-B LOGO Bug 状态

Registry 已更新 notes 确认：`sample_id` 是全局计数器（0-19999），`assign_groups` 创建的 10 组与深度强相关（group 0-2 ≈ pure d1, group 7-9 ≈ pure d3）。Sub-A 和 Sub-C 不受影响。Registry 建议用 per-depth seed assignment 重跑 LOGO。

[severity: info] Bug 已被识别和记录。Plan_015 若执行，其 Test A/B 可部分替代 Sub-B 的"域偏差"验证角色（不同方法学但同一核心问题）。建议 Director 判断：Sub-B LOGO 是否仍需重跑，还是 plan_015 wild calibration 足以覆盖域偏差论证？

---

GPU 0/1 均 0% 利用率、0 MiB 显存。Phase 2 写作阶段，两卡空闲。无越界进程风险。
